metadata.title: What key contextual factors contribute to students’ reading literacy among top-performing countries and economies? Statistical and machine learning analyses

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used a single plausible value (PV1READ) for analysis, which does not meet the criteria for proper handling of plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study uses ILSA student-level data but does not mention whether sampling weights were applied in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study appears to use student-level models without addressing school clustering, which is typical in ILSA data.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions using internal validation methods such as Shapley decomposition and gradient boosting decision trees, but does not report any validation on external datasets.
